# Local Chatterbox E2E corpus

This small original-fiction corpus exercises reflective narration, suspense,
an escalating Mara–Wren argument, an emotional turn, a reviewed fictional
pronunciation, sentence splits, paragraph splits, and an explicit pause. It is
covered by Yakbox's MIT license.

The joined chapter routes narration to Andy Minter, Mara to Caro Davy, and
Wren, a man, to Nick Whitley. Dialogue turns retain natural attribution and
enough context for Chatterbox; the corpus does not render a bare “No.” as a
standalone chunk.

`qa.toml` is the test and listening-review contract. Adjusting its passage and
profile lists, automated bounds, or manual dimensions changes the generated QA
package without changing the runtime implementation.
